name: Northshire Vineyards
summary: At Northshire Vineyards, Defias brigands have seized the fields east of Northshire Abbey. The grapes once supplied wine to the clerics, but now the thieves plunder the harvest and threaten local farmers.

sections.title: A Plundered Harvest
sections.body: Northshire Vineyards lie east across the stream from Northshire Abbey, where workers such as Milly Osworth once tended the fields. Defias Brotherhood brigands now hold the acreage, led by Garrick Padfoot. The thieves plunder the harvest and strip local farmers of their livelihood. Their occupation gives new Brotherhood recruits a foothold close to the abbey.

faq.q: Who controls the Northshire Vineyards right now?
faq.answer: Defias Brotherhood thieves and cutthroats occupy Northshire Vineyards. Garrick Padfoot leads them, directing the crop looting and terrorizing local workers.

faq.q: Why is the abbey letting bandits run rampant in the fields?
aliases: why isn't the abbey defending the vineyards
faq.answer: Stormwind's forces are stretched thin while King Varian Wrynn is missing. Abbey guards protect the abbey and watch the valley roads, leaving local farmers to depend on newly arrived adventurers to recover their stolen goods.
Milly Osworth is a local farmer who worked the vineyards. The Defias bandits drove her away when they seized the grape harvest, and she now asks travelers to recover her stolen crates.

angles.text: For many young humans venturing into the world, the occupied vineyards offer a first encounter with the Defias Brotherhood's reach and the bitterness it brings.
Unrest in these quiet grape fields shows how far lawlessness has spread, even into the most protected corners of the kingdom of Stormwind.
